issue_context.title: Source location of return instruction in a with block is incorrect
issue_context.body:
```
def f():
 with x:
   return 42

import dis
from pprint import pprint as pp
def pos(p):
    return (p.lineno, p.end_lineno, p.col_offset, p.end_col_offset)

pp([(pos(x.positions), x.opname, x.argval) for x in dis.get_instructions(f)])
```

review_comments: Why doesn't the RETURN_VALUE have the location of the return statement?
The calculation of the value has that location. The return itself occurs after the __exit__, so it gets the location of the __exit__ (the last instruction executed before the return).
